tool_args.rationale: The first fitted bridge branch model matched training exactly but missed fresh confirmation by 0.724, far above tolerance. All supplied rows share the same sink gradient, leaving sink inhibition and the local branch confounded. An open-branch discriminating probe varies the gradient and/or branch condition to distinguish the plausible siphon variants before fitting again.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: No evidence places the system near the avalanche threshold; it does not resolve the observed confirmation failure as directly.
The current rows have a single horizon and fixed state/memory, but the bridge signatures point to a static siphon/branch ambiguity rather than a memory-ODE trajectory.
Irrelevant auxiliary measurement; it cannot discriminate the candidate bridge mechanisms.
